content: पिङ्गल {%a.%} [पिङ्ग-सिध्मा˚ लच्, पिङ्गं लाति, ला-क वा <ls>Tv.</ls>] Reddish-brown, yellowish, brown, tawny; तेनोत्तीर्य पथा लङ्कां रोधयामास पिङ्गलैः (वानरैः) <ls>R. 12. 71</ls>; <ls>Ms. 3. 8</ls>; पिङ्गो दीपशिखाभः स्यात् पिङ्गलः पद्मधूलिवत्. .{@-लः@} .²1 The tawny colour. .²2 Fire. .²3 A monkey. .²4 An ichneumon. .²5 A small owl. .²6 A kind of snake. .²7 <ab>N.</ab> of an attendant on the sun. .²8 <ab>N.</ab> of one of Kuberaʼs treasures. .²9 <ab>N.</ab> of a संवत्सर (the 51st or 25th in the 60 years cycle). .²10 <ab>N.</ab> of a reputed sage, the father of Sanskrit prosody, his work being known as पिङ्गलच्छन्दःशास्त्र; छन्दोज्ञाननिधिं जघान मकरो वेलातटे पिङ्गलम् <ls>Pt. 2. 33</ls>. .{@-लम्@} .²1 Brass. .²2 Yellow orpiment. .{@-ला@} .²1 A kind of owl. .²2 The Śiśu tree (शिंशपा). .²3 A kind of metal. .²4 A particular vessel of the body; <ls>Ch. Up. 8. 6. 1</ls>. .²5 The female elephant of the south. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of a courtezan who became remarkable for her piety and virtuous life. (The Bhāgvata mentions how she and Ajāmīla were delivered from the trammels of the world.)
